name: Dialog
signature: Dialog(size: base|xl = base, spacing: default|compact = default, title: text, description: text, body: text) slots: body, actions
description: Modal (ui/dialog.tsx): max-w 512 (lg), 12px panel radius, 0.5px border-2, popover ground, shadow-overlay. Header grid px 20 pt 16 with title (text-base or text-xl, medium, balance) and ghost icon-sm close; description text-sm muted-fg-2 mt 4. Body px 20, gap 16 py 20 (compact gap 12 py 16). Footer flex end gap 8 px 20 pb 16. Opens with overlay fade 200ms ease-out and panel scale .95→1 200ms ease-out-quint; exits 150ms.
usage: <doop-use component="Dialog" size="base" spacing="default" title="…" description="…"><template slot="body">…</template><template slot="actions">…</template></doop-use>
